artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman holding a child closely. Their faces are depicted in detail, with the woman's head slightly tilted towards the child. Both figures have halos, and the woman's hair is flowing. Their clothing is intricately patterned with fabric folds. The background features ornate details like arched windows and circular designs. The color palette is muted, emphasizing the detailed elements in the scene.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated with their full body visible. The person's face is not identifiable due to heavy texturing. The person's hair appears to be long. The clothing covers most of the body and could be a robe-like garment. The background is dark and speckled, possibly representing intricate details or decorative motifs. The artwork appears weathered and aged.

artworks.title: Saint Michael

artworks.description: The image displays swirling and looping lines forming an intricate, textured pattern. The abstract artwork resembles a tapestry woven from Earth-toned fibers, with shades of brown, black, and orange. The interwoven lines create patterns that could be seen as resembling foliage or a rugged terrain. The complexity of the image draws connections to textures found in nature, such as tree bark or dried leaves, showcasing how abstract compositions can mimic the natural world.

artworks.title: Trinity
artworks.description: The image displays a dense arrangement of overlapping lines and shapes forming a rectangular block with uneven edges. The pattern is abstract, with dark and rusty hues creating a textured appearance. The irregular lines and patches suggest an organic quality, resembling tree bark or rocky landscape topography. The overall composition appears like a mosaic featuring dark and earthy tones.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.description: The image shows a square composition filled with dark, nebulous shapes and lines. These lines and forms create an abstract pattern, evoking a sense of weathered texture. The overall appearance is abstract, with interwoven and overlapping elements, resembling chaotic brushstrokes or a densely tangled ground.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.description: The image shows a weathered print of a figure in a seated position. The figure's face is not distinct, and they appear to wear a crown or halo. The person wears robes and holds an object. The background is dark with abstract patterns and the print is bordered with an orange-red frame on a beige or light brown surface.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine
artworks.description: The image shows a depiction of a figure, possibly a saint or religious icon, from the waist up. The figure has an upright posture with a tilted head and a raised arm. Facial features are unclear due to the aged condition of the image, but suggest a serene or focused expression. A halo-like structure surrounds the head. The clothing is detailed with flowing lines and patterns. The figure is within a decorative border with a red outer edge. The background is dark with flowing lines. The image appears old and worn, indicating historical or cultural significance.

artworks.title: Unknown Saint
artworks.description: The image shows a square area of a weathered piece of paper with a faded illustration of a figure seated in the center. The details of the person are indistinct due to the deterioration of the image, but there is a general outline of a human-like figure. The person's position seems to be sitting, and the facial features are not discernible. The figure appears to be cloaked or robed in a patterned garment with intricate designs that are obscured. The background contains indistinct motifs and patterns within a reddish-brown border. The surrounding paper displays signs of wear with an uneven texture and aged edges.

artworks.title: Unknown Saint
artworks.description: The image shows a textured depiction of a person. The figure is positioned centrally, faced forward, with obscured facial features. The outline of a head is visible, but hair details are not clear. The clothing forms flowing lines, possibly a robe, with no clear design details. No visible jewelry or objects are held. The aged background has a consistent mottled pattern.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.description: The image features abstract religious imagery with intricate linework, a detailed interwoven pattern suggesting outlines of figures within an enclosing rectangular form. The primary colors are earth tones with accents of deep blue against a rich, reddish-brown background creating a dominant texture. The style resembles an ancient religious manuscript or early printed work, possibly evoking early Christian or Byzantine iconography through its structural form and composition. The image is presented on textured paper or parchment, contributing to its aged and historical appearance.

artworks.title: The Sudarium
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and patterns in dark and reddish-brown colors, forming a rectangular shape. The design appears complex and mysterious, with intertwining lines resembling tangled vines or ripples on water. The overall texture is reminiscent of weathered wood grain or intricate animal fur patterns.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, blue, gold, and orange-red
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated on a green ground. The person has an oval face, light hair, and is dressed in a blue gown with full sleeves and a red draped cloak. They hold an open book in their right hand and a staff in their left hand. At their feet is a dragon or serpent-like creature. The background features blue horizontal lines against a plain backdrop. The image is framed with a red border and appears aged.

artworks.title: The Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, blue, tan, green, rose, gold, orange
artworks.description: The image shows three male figures and a central female figure from the waist up, seated in a triangular arrangement. The two male figures on the sides extend their right arms towards the female figure's head, holding parts of a crown above her head. Both men have halos. The figure on the left has shoulder-length brown hair and a beard, and the figure on the right has gray hair and a beard. They are dressed in long robes, with the left figure in a brown robe and the right figure in a deep red mantle over a green garment. The central female figure has long blond hair and wears a blue and gold robe over a beige dress, with a halo over her head. An additional figure, likely a dove with outstretched wings, is seen above the crown in the sky. The background is off-white with a hint of blue, enclosed in an orange border.

artworks.title: The Marriage of the Virgin
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, rose, blue, green, yellow, black, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring three figures. A central figure wearing a mitre and robe reaches out hands towards two other figures in ceremonial attire. The scene is set in an architectural interior with a patterned window on the right side. The color scheme includes blues, reds, greens, and an orange border. The style resembles early medieval manuscript illustrations.

artworks.title: The Ecstasy of Mary Magdalene
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, rose, gold, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her hands clasped near her chin. Surrounding her are four angelic figures, two on each side, wearing red robes. Below them is an upside-down head with a serene expression, surrounded by blue fabric and black triangular shapes or handles. The background is light beige with abstract colored shapes, enclosed by a bold red and orange border, and blue coloring at the top.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of a Saint
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, blue, rose, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a scene with a figure holding a sword above their head and another figure kneeling. The standing figure has a drawn sword, wearing a pointed hat, while the kneeling figure is dressed in a long robe with clasped hands and a serene expression. The kneeling figure has a halo around their head. The background is suggested with simple sketched lines, framed in red.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange-red lake, green, yellow, blue, gold, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual is facing forward with one hand raised and the other holding a large key. They have facial features that include a beard and short blue hair. The person is dressed in a long yellow tunic with a green lining, and a red cloak draped over it. They are against a background with light colors and blue horizontal lines, potentially representing a sky. The ground is green, and there is a decorative border surrounding the image.

artworks.title: Sacred Monogram in a Sacred Heart on a Cloth Held by an Angel
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, yellow, gold,and orange
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 8.2 x 6.5 cm (3 1/4 x 2 9/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 39.4 x 31.8 cm (15 1/2 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel holding a banner with a heart symbol. The image features a central figure with curly hair and wings, dressed in robes. The figure holds a banner with a large heart with the letters "IHS" inscribed on it, pierced by an arrow. There is text at the bottom in an old style of script. The background includes elements suggestive of an ethereal or heavenly setting, such as clouds and a border. The style of the artwork appears to have a religious or spiritual theme, reminiscent of illustrations from historical or medieval texts, with muted and earthy colors typical of earlier illustrative works.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with a Grape Vine
artworks.medium: woodcut with hand-coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with a figure on a cross draped with vines producing purple clusters. Below the figure, a person in a purple robe is present. The ground is decorated with plants and foliage. The colors are soft yet vibrant, enhancing the medieval style of the illustration. At the top of the cross is the inscription "INRI".

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man seated, with a slight tilt of his head to the left. He has a somber expression, large wide eyes, a full beard, dark wavy long hair reaching his shoulders, and is wearing a green crown of thorns. His body appears bare with red streaks suggesting wounds or blood. He wears a cloth around his waist and has crossed arms resting on a stone structure detailed in blue and yellow with arch-like designs. The background is an orange wall with faded letters, bordered by an ornate arch design with green and blue accents. The image has an aged, textured appearance similar to manuscript art.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing and holding a child. The person is upright with a crown on their head, long hair, a robe, and a scepter. The child also has a halo, and both figures wear necklaces. The background has a decorative border with floral elements and mythical creatures, featuring geometric and organic designs.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows
artworks.description: The image shows a person with long dark hair standing slightly bent forward, appearing to touch a large blue cloth. The person has a downcast expression and wears minimal clothing. In the background, there is a carved pillar with ropes and leafy decorations, as well as a scroll with arched text. The setting includes a decorated wall in shades of gold and green, contributing to a historical or religious atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, red, pink, yellow, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals. One person in the foreground is lying down with closed eyes and a beard. The other four individuals around them are positioned closely together, with two kneeling and two standing. They are supporting the person on the ground. The facial expressions of the individuals vary from closed or downcast eyes to subtle smiles. They have different hairstyles and head coverings. The individuals are wearing robes of different colors and one of them is dressed in white and holding the head of the person on the ground. The image has an aged texture, with an orange border and a cream-colored background.
